apush-mcq-0140.reason: Rationale C states 'Smallpox reached Tenochtitlan in 1520, during the siege.' False: the siege of Tenochtitlan was May-August 1521 (5 Steps Ch. 6: 'He besieged and overran Tenochtitlan in 1521'); the epidemic struck in late 1520, before the siege. Contradicts the lesson ('before the siege'). Stem and key D are fine; fix rationale C only.

apush-mcq-0141.reason: Stem states 'Smallpox reached Tenochtitlan in 1520, while Cortes and his forces were besieging the city.' False for the same reason: no siege was underway in 1520; the siege was 1521. Rationale A ('spread through Tenochtitlan during the siege') and general step 1 ('in 1520, during the siege') repeat the error. Key A is correct; fix the stem, rationale A, and general step 1 to 'before the siege.'
